subject: You're so vain..
author: ZombieTron
body:
you probably thought my blog was about you.

I was kinda worried that I had scared everyone off, but it's not rules only suggestions. 😉

Our intention isn't to stop people blogging or posting as much as they like and we wont be censoring anyone anytime soon unless they TOTALLY cross that invisible line.  We just want to make BurnoutAholics the best place it can be - and we can't do that without all the people who regularly contribute and make suggestions for improvements.

See Boot you didn't get busted, but keep watching your rear view for those flashing blue lights!
